messages:
Dan M: Heads-up — vendors just pushed a few regional windows for H100/H200 and MI300; also some changes to Gaudi enablement timing. Need quick alignment before we lock the marketplace embargo.
Priya S: How big are the shifts? Any hard embargo asks from partners?
NVIDIA - Kai: H200 NA freight pushed +7 days. We can still aim for the same press week if the announcement uses a soft availability window. Partners request a 48h pre-brief.
AMD - Lela: MI300 driver patch queued; if it lands tonight we stay on schedule, otherwise add ~1 week. No NDA changes.
Ops - Arlo: Practical constraints: Gaudi kernel regen ~24h, cross-region canary ~36h. If vendors flip firmware mid-cycle expect ~48h extra. Current canary snapshot:
```
base: rwd-ubuntu-22.04-gpu:2026-03-26
kernel: 6.1.82
cuda: 12.2
rocm: 5.9
model-optimizer: 3.2.4
```
Ops - Arlo: Recommend we publish public marketplace with a soft-window and stagger SI GA +14 days for integrator validation. That keeps press clean and gives SI partners runway.
Hannah (mkt): Agreed. I'll prepare soft-window assets plus a firm-date fallback. We need partner quotes ASAP to avoid last-minute edits.
Legal: We'll prepare two copy variants (soft + firm). Partner quotes must be verbatim; legal turnaround ~24h once drafts are tagged.
Dan M: Action items: @Ops - Arlo run canary and upload metrics to s3://redwood/embargo-sync/3625004321/; @Hannah draft assets (soft + firm); @Legal on the approval loop. I'll run a partner prebrief 10:00am PT. If canary is green and partners sign off, we target the tentative publish; otherwise hold and use non-dated messaging.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary-3625004321 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/3625004321/logs
deploy-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, artifacts -> s3://redwood/embargo-sync/3625004321/artifacts.tgz
Ops - Arlo: Canary PASS. Gaudi regen added ~22h total. B200 thermal shows +1.9% peak (within SLO). Full metrics uploaded to s3://redwood/embargo-sync/3625004321/metrics.json
NVIDIA - Kai: We'll review the soft assets after canary. Please label perf bullets as "preliminary" and avoid firm inventory promises.
AMD - Lela: Patch landed and validated on our side. No regressions.
Hannah (mkt): Soft-window draft uploaded and tagged Legal + Partners. Link: https://docs.redwood/announcements/drafts/3625004321 (internal)
Legal: Reviewing now. Reminder: any edits to partner quotes require partner re-approval. Expect ~24h turnaround.
Dan M: Thanks team. Running partner prebrief at 10:00am PT to lock windows. If partners push any red flags, we fall back to the non-dated copy. :white_check_mark:
